topicLinks.text: What's the best place to save a backup so I can find it again?

title: Save Copies of Returns for Your Records
headings: Save a Back-up Copy of Your Tax File
Save Your Returns as a PDF
text: Save Copies of Returns for Your Records We recommend that you make copies of your returns for your records and store them in a safe place. You can save a file to a removable media device, like a flash drive. Save a Back-up Copy of Your Tax File Save a back-up tax file that you can use to import your information next year. This back-up will save your federal and any state returns to 1 file. Insert your removable media device, like a flash drive before you start. Save Your Returns as a PDF Save a copy of all of your returns as a PDF. That way, you can view or print your return later without opening this program.
